profile.headline: Web Manager / Sound Designer
profile.geoLocationName: Baltimore City County, Maryland, United States
profile.summary: I am deeply fascinated with the profound impact of emerging technologies on the way we live, work, and play. With over 16 years of corporate, non profit, government and entrepreneurial IT experience, I have addressed leaders across the nation on the use of technology to increase productivity and metrics to increase performance. My experience includes being a member of the web systems team at the Maryland Department of Information and Technology (DoIT). Here, I supported high traffic/high visibility critical web projects. Notable achievements include launching the social media presence for the Maryland Emergency Management Agency and having a key role in the development of Maryland’s first emergency mobile app, MDPrepares.

positions.title: Manager of Web Services
positions.description:
• Provide leadership, vision and guidance in the planning, coordination and execution of activities associated with the architecture, functionality and governance of the University's public web properties
• Drive ongoing benchmarking, dashboard monitoring and analytics intelligence to support data-informed decision making
• Manage the University’s digital environment to ensure support of the University’s business goals and meet the functional and engagement needs of the target audience

positions.title: Principal
positions.description:
• Delivery online solutions on schedule, within budget and with high quality
• Determine pricing strategy and pricing model for B2B services
• Effectively communicate website project status, propose solutions and alternative strategies

positions.title: Webmaster II
positions.description:
• Acted as Assistant Director - managing the Web Systems, Web Application and Contractor teams
• Delivered web solutions across technologies and infrastructures to over 50 state agencies
• Interfaced with customers, vendors, and resellers to manage software licenses and software assurance procurement

positions.title: Webmaster
positions.description:
• Analyzed internal and external customer requirements to design, develop, test, implement and maintain user friendly web interfaces, database applications and web applications 
• Built and maintained web applications utilizing IIS, PHP, HTML, CSS, JavaScript, ASP.NET and MS SQL Server
